For each structure, the inputs are: every truncation of base (lengths 0 to len-1), every single-bit flip (bit b flips byte b/8, mask 1 << b%8), then splices base[..cut] ++ base[resume..] with cut and resume each floor(next() * len / 256), then randoms. next() is the LCG state = state * 1664525 + 1013904223 (mod 2^32), returning state >>> 24, seeded with seed. A random input of randomLength "base" is len bytes of zeros whose first 1 + (i % 24) bytes are next(); otherwise its length is ((next() << 8) | next()) % randomLength and every byte is next(). Even-numbered randoms (i % 2 == 0) then start with randomHead, when it fits. codes[i] is the stable ErrorCode number for input i, 0 when accepted. binding and capability are decoded then verified at now against leaf with no expected identity and nothing revoked; plaintext is decoded only.
